full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media ink portrait presents a middle-aged man from the shoulders upward against a warm, aged-paper background. His head fills almost the whole frame, with dark tousled hair reaching the upper edge and falling across one side of his forehead. The pale cream background remains visible as a narrow border beside his cheeks and shoulders; scattered spots, faint scratches, and thin vertical marks give it the look of worn paper. The man faces forward, looking toward the viewer through thin dark glasses with rounded rectangular lenses. Loose strands cross one lens, while the eyes remain visible beneath heavy brows. His expression is sober and unsmiling. A long nose and compressed lips sit above a dark moustache, and short facial hair deepens into a pointed beard around the chin. His cheekbones, under-eye hollows, and creases are shaped by dense charcoal-gray hatching rather than smooth photographic shading. A dark collar and layered black strokes occupy the lower corners; parts of the shoulder area break into rough abstract patches, so the bust seems to merge with the marks along the bottom edge. The linework varies from fine, wiry scratches in the hair and glasses to broad rubbed shadows around the jaw and clothing. The limited palette of ink black, weathered gray, and yellowed ivory keeps attention on the face and on the movement of the drawing. Light appears to come from the front and slightly above, leaving pale planes on the forehead and nose and darker pockets under the brows and chin. No readable words appear among the accidental-looking surface marks. The overall composition is tightly cropped, nearly symmetrical, and intense, combining precise facial observation with scuffed print texture and rough gestural energy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介墨绘肖像在暖色旧纸背景前呈现一名中年男子的肩上半身。他的头部几乎填满整个画幅，蓬乱的深色头发触及上缘，并落向额头一侧。浅奶油色背景只在脸颊和肩膀两旁留下窄边；散落的斑点、淡刮痕和细竖线让它看起来像磨旧的纸张。男子正面朝向观者，透过细黑框、圆角矩形镜片的眼镜望向前方。散开的发丝掠过一侧镜片，浓眉下的双眼依然可见。他神情严肃，没有笑意。长鼻与紧闭的嘴唇位于深色小胡子上方，短而密的面部毛发在下巴周围形成较尖的胡须。他的颧骨、眼下凹处和皱纹通过密集的炭灰色排线塑造，而不是平滑的摄影明暗。深色衣领和层叠的黑色笔痕占据下方角落；肩部一些区域裂解为粗糙的抽象色块，使半身像仿佛并入下缘的痕迹。线条从头发与眼镜处细而硬的刮线，变化为下颌和衣服周围宽阔擦涂的阴影。墨黑、旧灰和泛黄象牙白的有限配色让注意力集中在脸部和绘画痕迹的流动上。光仿佛来自正面略偏上方，在额头和鼻子上留下浅亮平面，在眉下与下巴下形成较深的暗处。那些仿佛偶然留下的表面痕迹中没有可读文字。整体构图裁切紧凑、接近对称而富有强度，将准确的面部观察与磨损的印刷肌理、粗放的手势感结合起来。
style_prompt_en: This mixed-media drawing combines dense black ink, dry gray rubbing, and a yellowed ivory ground. Fine scratched lines gather into dark masses, then disperse into isolated flecks and accidental-looking stains across quieter areas. Close-set hatching and abrupt patches of black model volume without relying on smooth gradients. Some contours are sharply traced, while others break apart into distressed edges and merge with the background. The palette is strongly restricted, with warm paper color acting as the lightest value and charcoal marks carrying most of the weight. Front-facing light is interpreted through pale unmarked planes and deeply crosshatched recesses. The composition favors a large central mass, tight cropping, and small margins that intensify its directness. The overall effect feels like a weathered print overworked by expressive drawing: exact in selected details, raw and fragmented elsewhere.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒介绘画结合密集黑墨、干擦的灰色与泛黄象牙白底色。细小刮线聚成深色块，再散成安静区域中的孤立斑点和仿佛偶然留下的污迹。紧密排线与突然出现的黑块在不依赖平滑渐层的情况下塑造体积。有些轮廓被清晰描出，另一些则碎裂成旧化边缘，融入背景。配色受到严格限制，暖纸色作为最亮明度，炭黑色痕迹承担大部分视觉重量。正面来光通过留白的浅亮平面和深度交叉排线的凹处来表现。构图偏向庞大的中央色块、紧凑裁切和狭窄边距，从而加强直接感。整体效果像一张被表现性绘画反复加工的旧版画：局部细节精确，其余区域粗粝而破碎。
theme_en: A stern bespectacled man rendered in distressed monochrome ink
theme_zh: 以旧化单色墨线描绘的严肃眼镜男子
name: Hideo Kojima
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
